confidence_notes: Beer, coffee and the two meal anchors are the best supported: several third-party aggregators (Numbeo figures via Expatica, Livingcost, MyLifeElsewhere, plus combien-coute and Expatistan) agree within a few dollars. Cocktail and wine are weaker, drawn from a rough Expatistan cocktail estimate, a few menu listings and a beer-based ratio, so treat them as low-medium. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for Tampa in July, not based on searched prices or live listings. Food and drink figures come from search snippets, not official statistics. FX 0.6720 for 2026-11-18 was taken from search results: the rba.gov.au page was not opened directly and a third-party site reports the same figure, so verify it against the RBA F11.1 table. The first FX search returned no RBA value, so FX was searched a second time in extended mode.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink anchors are Tampa-specific from aggregated third-party price data (Numbeo-style averages, cappuccino and draft beer snippets, and menu samples for wine and cocktails). Accommodation anchors are model estimates for a mid-sized Florida metro in July.
